name: livesync-engine
description: Node-consumable bundle of vrtmrz/livesync-commonlib, exposing DirectFileManipulator for the WebObsidian Self-hosted LiveSync backend.

vendored.note: upstream/src is an unmodified copy of livesync-commonlib's src/ at the pinned commit. Never edit it in place; to update, re-copy from upstream and rebuild. All Node-specific adaptation lives in build.mjs, shim.js and src/entry.ts.
vendored.xxhashNote: xxhash-wasm-102 is an npm ALIAS (npm:xxhash-wasm), matching upstream's Deno import map. It is currently unreferenced at runtime by the bundled V2 code path: XXHashHashManager.ts imports only `type XXHashAPI` from it (erased at build time), the actual xxhash comes from octagonal-wheels' own patched copy, and the one real value import lives in DirectFileManipulatorV1.ts which this bundle does not include. It is kept declared so the vendored source still typechecks and so a future switch to V1 resolves rather than failing cryptically.
vendored.sideEffectsNote: Do NOT add a "sideEffects" field. index.js imports shim.js purely for its side effect; marking the package side-effect-free would let a downstream bundler tree-shake the navigator shim away, which fails at runtime rather than at build time.
